output.english_question: Does Clause 9.3 of the Home Loan Agreement dated 2026-02-10, which requires the borrower to pay a 2% pre-payment charge on the principal outstanding for full or partial foreclosure/pre-payment, comply with the RBI’s current rules?
sub_queries: RBI current rules prepayment charges home loan foreclosure partial full 2%
RBI guidelines on foreclosure prepayment charges housing loans clause compliance
interpretation RBI pre-closure charges rate cap 2% principal outstanding
premises: The home loan agreement dated 2026-02-10 contains Clause 9.3.
Clause 9.3 requires a 2% pre-payment charge on principal outstanding for full or partial foreclosure/pre-payment.
The charge is applicable for both full and partial foreclosure/pre-payment.
